Guiding the path while letting the other side feel they still have agency
Avoiding all serious negotiation pressure

explanation.competitive: You steer without visibly grabbing the wheel.

Because it proves the negotiator is not strategic

It removes the need for the other side to think
It guarantees instant agreement
